Ivy: Quick follow-up on gateway resume tradeoffs. I prototyped a consensus-checkpoint option that is lighter than full KV restore.
Marco: How does the handshake look?
Ivy: Edge sends its last-known checkpoint id + op_count. Upstream replies with best-match checkpoint and a small replay window to warm KV. If no match, fallback policies: strict-reconstruct or best-effort fast-resume.
Priya: Need to be explicit about side-effectful routes (webhooks). They should default to strict-reconstruct.
Zane: Observability: add tags resume_path, replay_tokens, fallback_reason, divergence_flag.
Ivy: Also recommend short-lived HMAC-signed checkpoints (route-scoped) rather than client-exposed long tokens.
Marco: Memory/Circuit-breaker: reserve replay buffer per-stream and if exceeded, drop to best-effort with a header indicating "best_effort_resume":true.
Priya: UX: surface a session_reconnect header instead of "resume" to avoid product confusion.
infra-bot: Created INF-4810: "Checkpoint resume telemetry + headers" (https://tracker/internal/INF-4810).
Ivy: Action items: Ivy -> draft proto; Marco -> edge budget plan; Priya -> evals for divergence; Zane -> telemetry dashboard mock. Sync next Wed.
